name: Security Instrument Description 9
definition: Identifies the security instrument by its name and typical characteristics.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Code used to identify the financial instrument.

FullName.name: Full Name
FullName.definition: Full name of the financial instrument.

ShortName.name: Short Name
ShortName.definition: Short name of financial instrument in accordance with ISO 18774.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI) codification.

NotionalCurrency.name: Notional Currency
NotionalCurrency.definition: Currency in which the notional is denominated.

CommodityDerivativeIndicator.name: Commodity Derivative Indicator
CommodityDerivativeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the financial instrument falls within the definition of commodities derivative under the local regulation.

ValidCFIRule.definition: The CFI code must be a valid CFI code as defined by 10962.

ValidISINRule.definition: ISIN code must pass checksum validation.
